subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Building an Anti-Fraud Culture
description: A short lesson to help you apply Building an Anti-Fraud Culture.

hook.text: A company with the best controls still gets defrauded. The controls were there; the culture wasn't.

buildup.text: Anti-fraud culture means leadership sets the tone, rewards integrity, and acts swiftly when fraud is found.

discovery.text: Companies where leadership models ethical behavior have significantly lower fraud rates than peers.

twist.text: If the CEO ignores small ethical violations, employees learn that rules are optional. Culture erodes from the top.

climax.text: Controls catch fraud. Culture prevents it. The strongest defense is an organization that refuses to tolerate it.

punchline.text: Controls detect. Culture prevents. Leadership sets the tone.

quiz.question: What is the strongest defense against fraud?
options: A culture of integrity set by leadership
